resources.string: Take back control of YouTube. Zero ads, zero Shorts, custom Study & Relax environments, and daily timers—with zero data collection.
Know someone who needs a website or custom software? Earn 10% on every closed project.
Distraction-free, ad-free YouTube with Shorts blocked, Study/Relax environments, and daily time limits—built by Studio Mogli.
1. Your Google Account Stays Strictly Private
Sign-in happens directly on Google\'s official login page inside an isolated window. Studio Mogli never sees, touches, or stores your email or password.
2. Why We Technically Cannot Collect Your Data
This app has zero backend servers, zero analytics SDKs, and zero ad trackers. Your environments, channel lists, and daily timers stay 100% offline on your phone.
Tap the top-left pill to switch between Study (Whitelist) and Relax (Blacklist + 45 min/day timer) in one click. Tap Edit to add channels or adjust timers.
